title: The Arrest of Halloween’s Michael Myers
description:
On September 13, 2021, police received a call of a masked man walking on the beach with a bloody knife in Galveston, TX. People reported the man was dressed as the serial killer from the “Halloween” movie franchise, Michael Myers.
